messages:
emily: Quick sync — micro demo launch next Wed 9am PT. Need registration page, Zoom + backup capture, recording ownership, and a tight post-event follow-up. Main goal: capture 3x 60s clips for benchmark/social and one 5–7m product highlight for sales.
raj: I can build the reg page. Question: single CTA (watch live) or dual (watch + get excerpt)?
sophie: Dual CTA is fine but keep primary to live. Zoom settings: cloud record (gallery + active speaker), enable separate audio tracks, enable automatic transcription. Also set waiting room off, require passcode.
raj: For the reg page I’ll add two hidden fields: utm_campaign and demo_variant. Who owns copy for the secondary CTA?
emily: mike owns the messaging variants. mike: I’ll draft 2 subject lines + 2 CTAs. Suggest A: "See Redwood Inference live — demo + Q&A"; B: "Get the short product highlight — 60s preview after sign-up".
zara: Clip priority list: 1) 60s benchmark highlight (metric-focused), 2) 60s cost/latency win (before/after), 3) 60s prod UX walkthrough. Owner: @zara will craft edit notes, @raj will tag timestamps in cloud recording.
sophie: Zoom fallback — set RTMP to Recording Studio (backup ingest) and confirm at greenroom. Also enable "Record active speaker, gallery view" so we can stitch different shots.
recording-bot: Cloud recording scheduled: meeting_id=9876543210, cloud_recording_id=rec_311111. Link: https://zoom.us/rec/share/rec_311111 (placeholder)
raj: Reg page block for timezones: show local time widget, and add an option "I want a replay if I can't attend" (checked by default).
mike: Post-event workflow (proposed): T+10m send replay to registrants, with primary CTA = watch 60s clip; T+24h send product highlight (5–7m) to attendees only; T+3d nurture to non-attendees with benchmark PDF + invite to on-demand office hours.
emily: HubSpot lists: attendees vs registrants_no_show vs registrants_watched_clip. raj, make sure the reg form feeds those properties. Add hidden property "event_origin=launchpad_brief".
zara: For edit process: raj tags timestamps in comments like "00:03:12 - benchmark stat (use 0:00–0:60 clip)" and assign to @zara. Keep master edit in Google Drive under /Marketing/Events/Launchpad_Brief/.
sophie: Rehearsal: Wed prior at 30 mins. Host checklist: confirm co-hosts (emily, sophie), disable virtual backgrounds for recording, set mic levels. Also assign someone to monitor chat and clip note timestamps.
mike: Draft email snippets: subject A: "Live demo: how we cut inference cost by 3x"; alt subject B: "Watch a 60s highlight from our live demo". Preheader: "Join Wed 9am PT — replay if you can’t make it".
emily: Ownership recap: reg page + tags = raj, zoom config + rehearsal = sophie, messaging + email cadence = mike, clip edits = zara, I’ll own event coordination. Everyone react with :thumbsup: once you confirm.
raj: Confirmed. :thumbsup:
sophie: Confirmed. Added rehearsal to calendar invite.
mike: Confirmed, will drop copy by EOD today.
zara: Confirmed — will start edit notes during live.
emily: Awesome. If anything else, drop in this thread. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
